Neck pain, stiffness, and restricted movement have become increasingly common due to long hours of desk work, poor posture, and sedentary lifestyles. One of the most common causes of chronic neck discomfort is cervical spondylosis, an age-related condition that affects the bones, discs, and joints of the neck.

In Ayurveda, symptoms similar to cervical spondylosis are often described under Greevagraha, a condition characterized by neck stiffness, pain, and restricted movement resulting from aggravated Vata dosha.

At Praanavaidya, Ayurvedic therapies such as Greeva Basti are used as part of a holistic approach to support neck health, improve mobility, and enhance overall well-being.

What Is the Ayurvedic Treatment for Cervical Spondylosis?

Ayurvedic treatment for cervical spondylosis focuses on balancing aggravated Vata dosha, reducing stiffness, improving circulation, and nourishing affected tissues. Therapies such as Greeva Basti, Abhyanga, Swedana, herbal medicines, and lifestyle modifications are commonly recommended to help manage symptoms naturally.

What Is Cervical Spondylosis?

Cervical spondylosis refers to age-related wear and tear affecting the cervical spine (neck region).

It commonly develops due to:

  • Disc degeneration
  • Bone spur formation
  • Joint wear and tear
  • Poor posture
  • Repetitive neck strain
  • Long-term computer or mobile use

Most people develop some degree of cervical degeneration with age, although symptoms vary significantly.

Common Symptoms of Cervical Spondylosis

Symptoms may include:

  • Neck pain
  • Morning stiffness
  • Reduced neck mobility
  • Shoulder pain
  • Headaches originating from the neck
  • Tingling or numbness in the arms
  • Muscle tightness
  • Pain that worsens after prolonged sitting

When symptoms persist, professional evaluation is recommended.

Greevagraha: The Ayurvedic Perspective

In Ayurveda, neck stiffness and pain are often associated with Greevagraha.

The term combines:

  • Greeva – Neck
  • Graha – Stiffness, restriction, or obstruction

According to Ayurvedic principles, aggravated Vata dosha can affect muscles, joints, ligaments, and nerves, leading to pain, dryness, stiffness, and restricted movement.

Factors that may aggravate Vata include:

  • Irregular lifestyle habits
  • Poor posture
  • Excessive travel
  • Mental stress
  • Inadequate sleep
  • Aging
  • Excessive physical strain

What Is Greeva Basti?

Greeva Basti is a specialized Ayurvedic therapy designed specifically for the neck region.

During the procedure, a reservoir made of herbal dough is placed around the neck and filled with warm medicated oil. The oil is retained for a specific duration under professional supervision.

This localized therapy allows the warmth and herbal oils to act directly on the affected area.

How Greeva Basti Supports Cervical Spondylosis Management

Helps Reduce Neck Stiffness

The warmth of medicated oils helps relax tight muscles and improve flexibility.

Supports Joint Mobility

Many patients report improved neck movement after a series of Greeva Basti sessions.

Nourishes Neck Tissues

Ayurveda considers medicated oils beneficial for supporting tissues affected by aggravated Vata.

Promotes Local Circulation

Improved blood flow may help reduce muscular tension and support tissue health.

Encourages Relaxation

The therapy can help ease stress-related muscle tightness that often contributes to neck discomfort.

What Happens During a Greeva Basti Session?

A typical Greeva Basti session may involve:

Initial Assessment

The Ayurvedic practitioner evaluates symptoms, dosha imbalances, and overall health.

Preparation

The patient is positioned comfortably while a dough ring is placed around the cervical region.

Warm Oil Retention

Medicated oil is gently poured into the reservoir and maintained at a therapeutic temperature.

Therapy Duration

The oil remains in place for a specific period, usually determined by the practitioner.

Gentle Massage

In some cases, the session may be followed by a neck and shoulder massage.

Post-Therapy Care

Patients are advised regarding activity, posture, and home care recommendations.

Lifestyle Tips for Managing Cervical Spondylosis

Alongside Ayurvedic treatment for cervical spondylosis, lifestyle modifications can play a major role.

Maintain Proper Posture

Avoid prolonged neck bending while using computers or mobile devices.

Take Frequent Breaks

Stretch your neck and shoulders every 30–60 minutes during desk work.

Practice Neck Exercises

Gentle exercises recommended by healthcare professionals may improve flexibility.

Sleep Correctly

Use a supportive pillow that maintains natural neck alignment.

Manage Stress

Stress often contributes to muscle tension and worsening symptoms.

Who May Benefit from Greeva Basti?

Greeva Basti may be considered for individuals experiencing:

  • Cervical spondylosis
  • Chronic neck stiffness
  • Postural neck pain
  • Neck muscle tightness
  • Cervical discomfort associated with Vata imbalance

Suitability should always be assessed by a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner.
